dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. It's old, but I like it.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ɪts ˈoʊld, bʌt aɪ ˈlaɪk ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh! Is this a photo of your family?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ! ɪz ðɪs ə ˈfoʊtoʊ əv jʊr ˈfæməli?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! My mom, my dad, Fah, and me.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! maɪ ˈmɑːm, maɪ ˈdæd, ˈfɑː, ənd ˈmiː.
